summary.text: Jon Penn Junejo is the Democratic candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Gregory Hafen.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a board-certified psychiatric provider running to expand access to healthcare, strengthen public education and improve economic stability for working families.

paragraphs.text: Junejo said in his Ballotpedia survey that he was born in Sindh, was raised in the United States by his mother, a physician, and lived in 12 states before high school.

He said he worked as a healthcare strategy analyst and business professional, earning degrees from the University of Utah, Duke University and Saint Louis University, before joining AmeriCorps during the COVID-19 pandemic.
He said he earned a doctorate in psychiatry from Columbia University and has practiced in underserved rural communities across multiple states and now serves patients in Nevada.

Junejo listed expanding mental healthcare access, including local crisis stabilization services, improving early literacy and teacher recruitment and retention, and lowering the cost of living as his key messages.
